audience.text: Python developers building OMR applications who need to generate printable bubble-sheet forms and recognize filled scans using the Aspose API surface without .NET dependencies.

capabilities.text: Generate printable PNG pages and machine-readable .omr descriptors from text-markup DSL files or TemplateConfig trees using OmrEngine.Generate.
capabilities.title: Form generation from markup or code

capabilities.text: Register scans using four corner fiducials to handle any cardinal rotation, skew, perspective, scanner banding, and partial fiducial loss.
capabilities.title: Robust scan registration

capabilities.text: Classify filled vs blank bubbles using fixed or auto-calibrated thresholds, with multiselect validation via FormValidationLogic.
capabilities.title: Mark classification and validation

capabilities.text: Export recognition results as CSV, JSON, or XML using RecognitionResult methods.
capabilities.title: Result export in multiple formats

capabilities.text: Class, method, property, enum-type, and enum-member names are preserved character-for-character from Aspose.OMR for .NET v26.1.0.
capabilities.title: API fidelity to Aspose.OMR for .NET

capabilities.text: Process multiple scans via RecognizeFolder to handle batch recognition workflows.
capabilities.title: Batch processing support

capabilities.text: Call TemplateProcessor.Recalculate on a RecognitionResult with a new threshold to re-score without re-reading pixels.
capabilities.title: Re-scoring without re-sampling

limitations.text: Registration fails silently under extreme oblique perspective or combined skew/perspective with fiducial occlusion.
Grid orientation follows .NET spec: horizontal = each digit is a column of bubbles, vertical = each digit is a row.
Some attributes like choicebox.display_number, option.row_index, and block.background_color are accepted but not rendered.
SaveAsPdf and GetPDF raise NotImplementedError as PDF output is deferred.

problems_solved.text: Enables end-to-end OMR workflows—authoring forms in code or text markup, generating printable PNGs and machine-readable .omr descriptors, and recognizing filled scans—using a pure Python stack.
Provides robust registration for real-world scans, handling any cardinal rotation, skew, perspective distortion, scanner banding, and partial fiducial loss.
Supports multiple output formats (CSV, JSON, XML) for recognition results and allows re-scoring via Recalculate without re-reading pixels.

product_summary.text: A Python library for Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) that ports the Aspose.OMR for .NET v26.1.0 API name-for-name, enabling form generation and scan recognition using numpy, opencv-python, and Pillow.

workflows.name: Generate form from markup
workflows.text: Pass a .txt file or string list to OmrEngine.Generate to produce a printable PNG and .omr descriptor using the Aspose text-markup DSL.

workflows.name: Generate form in code
workflows.text: Build a TemplateConfig tree programmatically and pass it to OmrEngine.Generate to produce a printable PNG and .omr descriptor.

workflows.name: Recognize filled scan
workflows.text: Use TemplateProcessor.Recognize on a scan image to detect marks, returning a RecognitionResult with per-bubble fill values and recognized answers.

workflows.name: Export results
workflows.text: Call RecognitionResult.GetCsv, GetJson, or GetXml to export recognition results in structured formats.
